query: SELECT u.day,u.engine,COUNT(*) AS taskCount,SUM(u.total_tokens) AS "totalTokens",SUM(u.input_tokens) AS "inputTokens",SUM(u.output_tokens) AS "outputTokens",SUM(u.cache_read_tokens) AS "cacheReadTokens",SUM(u.cache_write_tokens) AS "cacheWriteTokens" FROM token_usage_daily u WHERE u.day>=json_extract(?1,'$.year')||'-01-01' AND u.day<=(json_extract(?1,'$.year')||'-12-31') AND (json_extract(?1,'$.engine') IS NULL OR u.engine=json_extract(?1,'$.engine')) GROUP BY u.day,u.engine ORDER BY u.day,u.engine
details: SELECT u.task_id AS taskId,u.engine,COALESCE(NULLIF(t.title,''),p.preview,'') AS title,SUM(u.total_tokens) AS "totalTokens",SUM(u.input_tokens) AS "inputTokens",SUM(u.output_tokens) AS "outputTokens",SUM(u.cache_read_tokens) AS "cacheReadTokens",SUM(u.cache_write_tokens) AS "cacheWriteTokens" FROM token_usage_daily u LEFT JOIN managed_tasks t ON t.id=u.task_id LEFT JOIN managed_task_previews p ON p.task_id=u.task_id WHERE u.day>=json_extract(?1,'$.year')||'-01-01' AND u.day<=(json_extract(?1,'$.year')||'-12-31') AND (json_extract(?1,'$.engine') IS NULL OR u.engine=json_extract(?1,'$.engine')) AND u.day=json_extract(?1,'$.day') GROUP BY u.task_id,u.engine ORDER BY SUM(u.total_tokens) DESC,u.task_id LIMIT 50
